All tests pass (this is the only `*AgentTest.java` in the project currently).

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/exception/ExceptionUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `ExceptionUtils`'s public/package-private API: cause chain traversal (`getCause`, `getRootCause`, `getThrowableList/Count/s`, cyclic chains), stack trace helpers (`getStackTrace`, `getStackFrame(s)`, `getRootCauseStackTrace(List)`), lookup methods (`indexOf*`, `throwableOf*`), predicates (`isChecked`/`isUnchecked`, `hasCause`), the rethrow/erasure tricks (`asRuntimeException`, `rethrow`, `throwUnchecked` both overloads, `wrapAndThrow`), printing overloads with null-argument edge cases, and `removeCommonFrames`. All 62 test methods pass under `--release 8` with no lambdas or diamond operators.
